overview.zh: 受监管的加密资产与AI能力同步向主流金融和公共领域渗透，机构与监管方成为关键推动者。 AI人才争夺：迪士尼拟三年投入约1.8亿美元接收Character.AI的66名员工，后者申请破产时仅剩18名全职员工。 银行渠道：德国储蓄银行自10月19日起分批开放加密交易，预计每月新增30至40家机构接入。 存款上链：摩根大通在以太坊推出JPM Coin存款代币，仅限经审核的机构对手方持有并可随时赎回美元。
overview.en: Regulated crypto rails and AI capacity are moving into mainstream finance and public hands, with institutions and regulators setting the terms. AI talent race：Disney plans to spend about $180 million over three years on 66 Character.AI employees; the platform had 18 full-time staff left at filing. Bank channel：German savings banks began phased crypto trading on Oct. 19, with 30 to 40 more institutions expected to join each month. Deposits onchain：JPMorgan launched its JPM Coin deposit token on Ethereum, restricted to vetted institutional counterparties and redeemable for dollars at any time.

title.zh: Character.AI破产细节曝光：迪士尼三年拟花1.8亿美元留人，平台只剩18人
title.en: Character.AI bankruptcy details emerge: Disney plans to spend $180 million over three years to keep staff, platform down to 18 people

summary.zh:
破产法院文件显示，Character.AI 申请破产前，迪士尼已向其 66 名员工发出工作邀请，其中 56 人已离职，另有 10 人正在等待工作签证调整；迪士尼预计未来三年为这批员工投入约 1.8 亿美元，其中包括 3000 万美元留任奖励。Character.AI 申请破产时仅剩 18 名全职员工。

美国 40 名州级总检察长已介入破产程序，要求保护用户私人聊天记录，防止这些数据在资产出售后被滥用。其他买家可在 11 月 20 日前提交竞购报价，若最终无人愿意继续运营，Character.AI 将关闭服务。

迪士尼对 Character.AI 部分技术和专利的报价仅 2000 万美元，换取永久、非独家的使用权，协议明确排除现有 App、品牌、用户聊天记录和成品模型。公司预计只有约 8 人留到破产程序关键阶段，其中约 6 人负责安全相关工作；迪士尼还将让部分已转岗员工临时回来，协助维持原平台运营。
summary.en:
Bankruptcy court filings show Disney had already offered jobs to 66 Character.AI employees before the company filed, with 56 having left and 10 awaiting work-visa adjustments; Disney expects to spend about $180 million on the group over three years, including $30 million in retention bonuses. Character.AI had only 18 full-time employees remaining when it filed for bankruptcy.

Forty state attorneys general have intervened in the bankruptcy proceedings to protect users' private chat logs from misuse after any asset sale. Other buyers can submit bids until November 20, and the service will be shut down if no one is willing to keep operating it.

Disney's $20 million bid covers a perpetual, non-exclusive license to parts of Character.AI's technology and patents, and explicitly excludes the existing app, brand, user chat logs and finished models. About 8 staff are expected to remain through the key stage of the proceedings, roughly 6 of them on safety-related work, and Disney will temporarily bring back some already-transferred employees to help keep the original platform running.

title.zh: 【德国储蓄银行开始逐步上线加密货币交易服务】
title.en: German savings banks begin phased rollout of cryptocurrency trading services

summary.zh:
据德国储蓄银行与汇划银行协会（DSGV）消息，自 10 月 19 日起，首批参与的德国储蓄银行（Sparkassen）客户可通过现有的储蓄银行 App 交易加密货币。首批支持的币种包括 BTC、ETH、XRP、SOL 及 POL，各家储蓄银行自行决定上线时间，此后预计每月新增 30 至 40 家机构接入。

此举使加密货币交易能够在受监管的前提下，进入德国覆盖面最广的本地银行网络。据 DSGV 官网数据，截至 2026 年 8 月德国共有 337 家独立运营的储蓄银行；协会计划在 2027 年上半年覆盖大部分有意参与的储蓄银行。

该服务由储蓄银行集团旗下证券服务商 DekaBank 提供，加密资产由 DekaBank 与斯图加特证券交易所合作托管，每笔订单收费约 0.99 欧元（约 1.11 美元）。DSGV 表示，服务面向希望自主买卖和托管加密货币的客户，储蓄银行不会提供投资建议，也不会大范围主动推广，并会明确提示客户注意价格大幅波动及全部亏损的风险。
summary.en:
Germany's savings banks (Sparkassen) began a phased rollout on Oct. 19 allowing customers of the first participating institutions to trade cryptocurrencies through their existing Sparkasse apps, according to the German Savings Banks and Giro Association (DSGV). The initial lineup covers BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL and POL, with each savings bank setting its own go-live date and 30 to 40 additional institutions expected to join each month.

The move opens regulated retail crypto trading inside Germany's dominant local banking network, which DSGV's own website counted at 337 independent savings banks as of August 2026, with the association targeting coverage of most interested institutions by the first half of 2027.

The service is provided by DekaBank, the group's securities services provider, with crypto assets custodied by DekaBank in cooperation with the Stuttgart Stock Exchange, at a fee of about €0.99 (US$1.11) per order. DSGV said the offering targets customers who want to buy, sell and custody crypto themselves; the savings banks will not provide investment advice or market the service broadly, and will explicitly warn of sharp price swings and the risk of total loss.

title.zh: THORChain 计划通过 v3.21 漏洞修复重启 Rujira
title.en: THORChain Targets Rujira Restart With v3.21 Exploit Fix

summary.zh:
THORChain 正在筹备 v3.21 协议升级，该版本修复了 Rujira 上 FIN 合约的漏洞，并旨在让已暂停的应用层（App Layer）重新启动。根据其发布说明，网络目标区块为 28,366,100，预计在 10 月 23 日（周五）前后到达。

Rujira 是 THORChain 的应用层，因此该漏洞迫使其实交易与流动性功能在补丁部署前暂停。升级完成后仍需节点运营者执行重启，这意味着恢复运行不仅取决于代码发布，还取决于运营者的参与。

该修复专门针对 Rujira 上 FIN 合约的漏洞，THORChain 已设定升级区块高度，预计激活时间约为 10 月 23 日。发布说明指出，应用层恢复上线仍需节点运营者执行重启。
summary.en:
THORChain is preparing a v3.21 protocol upgrade that patches the exploit in Rujira's FIN contract and is intended to allow the halted App Layer to restart. The network is targeting block 28,366,100, expected around Friday, Oct. 23, according to its release notes.

Rujira is THORChain's App Layer, so the exploit forced its trading and liquidity functions to halt until the patch is deployed. A node-operator restart is still required after the upgrade, meaning the restart depends on operator participation rather than the code release alone.

The fix is specifically aimed at the FIN contract exploit on Rujira, and THORChain has set an upgrade block height with an expected activation date of around Oct. 23. The release notes state that a node-operator restart is still needed for the App Layer to come back online.

title.zh: 摩根大通将存款代币引入以太坊，面向机构客户开放
title.en: JPMorgan Brings Deposit Token to Ethereum for Institutional Clients

summary.zh:
摩根大通已在以太坊上为机构客户推出 JPM Coin 存款代币，持有者目前可在以太坊与 Coinbase 的 Base 网络之间转移该代币。每一单位代币对应一笔已存放于摩根大通账户中的美元，可随时无锁定期赎回为美元，但仅限经过审核批准的对手方持有。

此举将受监管的银行存款负债放上公链，使代币化存款结算不再局限于单一自有网络或 Layer 2 网络。摩根大通区块链部门 Kinexys Labs 全球负责人 Emma Landriault 将其描述为"华尔街与加密行业进一步融合"的一年的一部分。

摩根大通预计加密企业将把该代币用于支付，而金融机构则用于结算代币化资产交易或缴纳抵押品。Kinexys 累计处理交易额超过 4 万亿美元，日均约 70 亿美元，而摩根大通整体支付业务日均约 12 万亿美元。
summary.en:
JPMorgan has launched its JPM Coin deposit token on Ethereum for institutional clients, and holders can now move the token between Ethereum and Coinbase's Base network. Each unit represents a dollar already held in a JPMorgan account and is redeemable for dollars at any time with no lock-up, but only vetted, approved counterparties are permitted to hold it.

The move puts a regulated bank-deposit liability on a public blockchain, extending tokenized-deposit settlement beyond a single proprietary or Layer 2 network. Emma Landriault, global head of Kinexys Labs at JPMorgan's blockchain unit, framed it as part of a year of "further convergence between Wall Street and crypto."

JPMorgan expects crypto firms to use the token for payments while financial institutions use it to settle trades in tokenized assets or post collateral. Kinexys has processed more than $4 trillion in transactions at roughly $7 billion a day, compared with about $12 trillion a day across JPMorgan's broader payments business.

title.zh: 美国CFTC在关于永续期货的关键争端中驳斥CME的法律立场
title.en: U.S. CFTC rebuffs CME legal stance in consequential fight over perpetual futures

summary.zh:
据CoinDesk报道，美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）在围绕永续期货监管的争端中驳斥了芝加哥商品交易所集团（CME）的法律立场。报道称，这场争端对美国用户能否接触这一热门加密衍生品具有重大影响。

CoinDesk称，这场争端可能影响美国市场对永续期货的准入，而永续期货是交易广泛的加密衍生品。
summary.en:
The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission rebuffed CME Group's legal position in a dispute over the regulation of perpetual futures, CoinDesk reported. The report described the fight as consequential for U.S. access to the popular crypto derivative product.

CoinDesk said the dispute could shape U.S. access to perpetual futures, a widely traded crypto derivative.

title.zh: Coinbase 通过 Deribit 打通美国与离岸加密衍生品市场
title.en: Coinbase Links US and Offshore Crypto Derivatives Markets via Deribit

summary.zh:
Coinbase 正将其美国衍生品业务与 Deribit 的离岸衍生品交易市场连接起来，Startup Fortune 报道称此举扩大了加密衍生品交易的跨市场准入。Coinbase 的帮助页面将该举措描述为把 Coinbase International Exchange 的全球覆盖与 Deribit 的衍生品技术整合为一个统一交易平台；CryptoTimes 于 2026 年 10 月 7 日报道称该整合已经完成。

Coinbase 表示，合并这两个平台旨在带来更深的流动性、更快的执行速度和更强的风控框架，并支持推出新产品。该连接为面向美国的账户提供了进入 Deribit 离岸衍生品订单簿的通道。

据 CryptoTimes 报道，已完成的整合将美国与全球加密衍生品流动性统一起来，并扩大了期权、现货保证金和统一投资组合的准入范围。Coinbase 自己的帮助页面则称，两个平台联手打造统一的衍生品交易体验。
summary.en:
Coinbase is linking its US derivatives business with Deribit's offshore derivatives marketplace, a move reported by Startup Fortune as expanding cross-market access to crypto derivatives trading. Coinbase support pages describe the effort as combining Coinbase International Exchange's global reach with Deribit's derivatives technology into a unified trading platform, and CryptoTimes reported on Oct. 7, 2026 that the integration had been completed.

Coinbase says combining the two venues is intended to deliver deeper liquidity, faster execution and a stronger risk framework, and to support new product offerings. The link gives US-facing accounts a route into Deribit's offshore derivatives order books.

According to CryptoTimes, the completed integration unites US and global crypto derivatives liquidity and expands access to options, spot margin and unified portfolios. Coinbase's own help pages describe the two platforms as joining forces to create a single derivatives trading experience.

title.zh: 【Mesh 与 Visa 达成合作，实现加密货币余额直接消费】
title.en: Mesh partners with Visa to enable direct spending of crypto balances

summary.zh:
加密支付网络 Mesh 宣布与 Visa 达成战略合作，接入 Mesh 的数字钱包和平台用户可在 Visa 全球受理网络中，直接使用钱包内的加密货币、稳定币及法币余额进行线下及线上消费。Mesh 将在后台为用户生成 Visa 支付凭证，用户可通过标准非接触式终端付款，商户端仍按常规方式收款，无需更换设备或调整收款流程。

该集成使用户无需提前出售或转账至银行账户，也无需单独申请加密银行卡，即可在商户处直接花掉钱包内的余额。据 Visa 表述，其网络覆盖 200 多个国家和地区的逾 1.75 亿个商户受理点。

Mesh 将作为项目管理方，负责用户开户及 KYC，并负责每笔交易的资金调配及加密资产、稳定币与法币之间的兑换。首批上线时间、支持设备及合作平台将在推出细节确定后公布。
summary.en:
Crypto payments network Mesh announced a strategic partnership with Visa that lets users of participating digital wallets and platforms pay directly with cryptocurrency, stablecoin and fiat balances across Visa's global acceptance network, both in stores and online. Mesh provisions a Visa payment credential in the background so users can tap a standard contactless terminal, while merchants keep receiving funds through their normal Visa checkout flow.

The integration removes the need to pre-sell or transfer assets to a bank account, or to obtain a separate crypto card, before spending wallet balances at merchants. Visa said its network covers more than 175 million merchant locations across over 200 countries and territories.

Mesh will act as program manager, handling customer onboarding and KYC as well as funding and conversion between cryptocurrencies, stablecoins and fiat for each transaction. First launch timing, supported devices and participating platforms will be announced once rollout details are finalized.

title.zh: ⚡️Metaplanet获批控股纳斯达克上市公司SLE，成功实现在美上市布局
title.en: Metaplanet Approved to Take Control of Nasdaq-Listed SLE, Completing Its US Listing Footprint

summary.zh:
Metaplanet 创始人兼 CEO Simon Gerovich 于 10 月 19 日宣布，其与纳斯达克上市公司 Super League Enterprise（SLE）的交易已在该公司股东大会上获得正式批准。Metaplanet 将注入 2,100 枚比特币及 250 万美元现金（总值约 1.346 亿美元），换取约 4486 万股、每股 3 美元的新发行普通股以及优先股和认股权证，从而取得 SLE 的控股权。

Gerovich 表示，交易完成后该公司将作为 Metaplanet 在美国上市的比特币财库平台，使其能够直接接入美国资本市场并获得更灵活的融资能力。结合在日本设立的 Metaplanet Securities，此次获批将使公司在全球两大资本市场上拥有互补性平台。

据 BlockBeats，Metaplanet 将持有 SLE 约 95.7% 的已发行普通股；而 Cointelegraph 对同一批准消息的报道给出的持股比例为 93.7%。Super League 计划更名为 Superplanet 并启用纳斯达克代码 SUPA，拟主要通过高级非 convertible 永续优先股而非债务为后续比特币购买融资，Metaplanet 另拥有最多 2.1 亿美元初级优先股的投资选择权；Metaplanet 所持普通股设有五年锁定期。
summary.en:
Metaplanet founder and CEO Simon Gerovich said on Oct. 19 that the company's deal with Nasdaq-listed Super League Enterprise (SLE) was formally approved at the company's shareholder meeting. Metaplanet will contribute 2,100 BTC plus $2.5 million in cash, worth roughly $134.6 million, in exchange for about 44.86 million newly issued common shares at $3 per share plus preferred stock and warrants, giving it control of SLE.

Gerovich said that after closing, the company will serve as Metaplanet's US-listed Bitcoin treasury platform, giving it direct access to US capital markets and more flexible financing. Combined with Metaplanet Securities in Japan, the approval gives the firm complementary platforms in the two largest capital markets.

Metaplanet will hold about 95.7% of SLE's issued common shares per BlockBeats, while a Cointelegraph report on the same approval put the ownership stake at 93.7%. Super League plans to rebrand as Superplanet with the Nasdaq ticker SUPA, intends to finance further Bitcoin purchases mainly through senior non-convertible perpetual preferred stock rather than debt, and Metaplanet holds an option to invest up to $210 million in junior preferred stock; Metaplanet's common shares are subject to a five-year lock-up.

summary.zh:
币安宣布在全球范围内推出币安 AI Pro，这是一款专注金融领域的 AI Agent，可将用户通过对话描述的交易想法转化为经过测试的自动化策略，策略参数完全由用户自行设定。自 2026 年 10 月 19 日起，该产品将在币安网页端和币安 App 上面向全球所有用户开放。

币安表示，用户无需编程即可构建自动化策略，这降低了全球最大交易所之一上零售用户进行策略自动化的技术门槛。

策略先通过模拟交易进行测试，经用户批准后才部署至实盘；每个实盘策略在独立子账户中运行，资金只能由用户手动划转。免费标准版每月提供 25 万额度，可使用 DeepSeek 模型；月费 19.99 USDC 的高级版每月提供 1000 万额度，并支持 ChatGPT Sol、ChatGPT Astra、Claude Opus 等模型（视地区而定）。此前推出的 Beta 版将继续运行，用户可选择将聊天记录和策略迁移至新版本。
summary.en:
Binance announced the global rollout of Binance AI Pro, a finance-focused AI agent that converts trading ideas described in conversation into tested, automated strategies whose parameters are set by the user. The rollout covers the Binance website and app for all users globally starting 2026-10-19.

Binance says the product lets users build automated strategies without coding, lowering the technical barrier to strategy automation for retail users on one of the largest exchanges.

Strategies are first tested through simulated trading and deployed to live trading only after user approval; each live strategy runs in a separate sub-account, and funds can only be moved manually by the user. A free Standard tier offers a 250,000 monthly quota with access to the DeepSeek model, while a Premium tier at 19.99 USDC per month offers a 10 million monthly quota and access to models including ChatGPT Sol, ChatGPT Astra and Claude Opus, depending on region; the earlier Beta version continues to run and users can migrate chat history and strategies to the new version.

title.zh: 某山寨币1,404个钱包被掏空：网络已暂停，交易所采取行动！
title.en: 1.404 Wallets Drained on an Altcoin: Network Halted, Exchanges Take Action!

summary.zh:
据Koin Bülteni报道，某未具名山寨币网络上共有1,404个钱包被掏空，随后该网络被暂停，多家交易所也采取了保护性措施。报道摘要中未点名受影响资产，也未给出损失金额。

网络暂停加上交易所的应对措施，表明该事件被当作一起仍在发酵、影响该链持有者的安全事件来处理，而非孤立的个人钱包被盗。

报道给出的数字是1,404个钱包被掏空。受影响的具体币种、攻击路径以及损失估算均未在来源摘要中披露。
summary.en:
Koin Bülteni reported that 1,404 wallets were drained on an unnamed altcoin network, after which the network was halted and exchanges took protective action. The report does not name the affected asset or quantify the losses in the excerpt.

The network halt and exchange countermeasures indicate the incident is being handled as a live compromise affecting holders on that chain, rather than an isolated individual wallet theft.

The headline figure is 1,404 wallets drained. The affected asset, the attack vector and any loss estimate are not disclosed in the source excerpt.

title.zh: Anthropic 将自身 5% 股份献给公众，马斯克回应：送出 SpaceX 股票
title.en: Anthropic Gives 5% of Itself to the Public. Musk Answers by Giving Away SpaceX Shares

summary.zh:
Anthropic 周日表示，将把公司 5% 的股份投入新设立的“公共利益基金”（Public Benefit Fund），该安排尚需股东批准；若计入联合创始人及员工的捐赠承诺，公司约 20% 的股份将用于公共事业。不到一天后，埃隆·马斯克在 X 上发文称，明年将向全美每一名儿童赠送一股他持有的 SpaceX 股票，并称这“只是众多举措中的第一个”。

此举将一家前沿 AI 实验室的部分股权纳入了面向公共利益的捐赠载体；而马斯克的对抗性承诺把讨论引向了另一条路径——把股票直接分发给个人，而非通过基金来做。

该基金设立为一家全资有限责任公司，而非非营利组织，Anthropic 称这使其可以在不同捐赠方式之间灵活切换；每当公司估值较未披露的基准上涨 50%，董事会可再追加 2% 的股份，且基金持有的股权不得用于游说或政治捐款。马斯克的承诺覆盖约 7200 万名美国儿童，按 SpaceX 每股约 147 美元计算价值约 105 亿美元，仅为其截至 6 月 30 日持有的 64.2 亿股（据 SEC 文件）的 1% 出头。
summary.en:
Anthropic said Sunday it will commit 5% of its shares to a new Public Benefit Fund, subject to stockholder approval, and says roughly 20% of its stock will go to public causes once co-founder and employee pledges are counted. Less than a day later, Elon Musk posted on X that he will give one of his SpaceX shares to every child in the United States next year, calling it "the first of many."

The move puts a slice of a frontier AI lab's equity into a vehicle for public-benefit giving, and Musk's counter-pledge redirected the discussion toward distributing shares directly to individuals rather than routing them through a fund.

The fund is structured as a wholly owned limited-liability company rather than a nonprofit, which Anthropic says gives it room to switch between types of giving; the board can add another 2% of shares each time the company's value rises 50% above an undisclosed baseline, and none of the fund's equity may be used for lobbying or political donations. Musk's pledge covers roughly 72 million US children, about $10.5 billion at SpaceX's price of roughly $147 a share — just over 1% of the 6.42 billion shares he held as of June 30, per an SEC filing.

title.zh: 黑客攻击 AI 编程工具 OpenCode，导致用户 AI 账户产生高额费用
title.en: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts

summary.zh:
黑客侵入了 OpenCode 在线平台的一部分，窃取了部分用户的 API 密钥，并利用这些密钥在受害者的 AI 账户上刷出高额费用。据报道，OpenCode 求助的 AI 工具多次拒绝查看这些恶意代码。

被盗密钥让攻击者能够消耗由受影响用户付费的 AI 调用额度，使一次凭证泄露直接变成使用该工具的开发者们的经济损失。

此次入侵影响的是 OpenCode 在线平台的一部分，而非其开源代码库本身。OpenCode 以终端界面、桌面应用和网页应用三种形式提供。
summary.en:
Hackers breached part of OpenCode's online platform and stole some users' API keys, then used those keys to run up charges on the victims' AI accounts. According to the report, the AI tools OpenCode consulted for help repeatedly refused to examine the malicious code.

The stolen keys gave attackers a way to consume paid AI capacity billed to affected users, turning a credential leak into direct financial loss for developers using the tool.

The intrusion affected part of OpenCode's online platform rather than the open-source codebase itself. OpenCode is distributed as a terminal-based interface, a desktop app and a web app.

title.zh: Tenstorrent 估值达 62 亿美元，加速扩展开放权重 AI 芯片业务
title.en: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips

summary.zh:
AI 芯片公司 Tenstorrent 于 10 月 19 日宣布完成 15 亿美元 E 轮融资，投后估值达 62 亿美元。本轮由 Trace Capital 和 Innovation X 领投，新老投资者参投，包括 ARK Invest、富达管理与研究公司、摩根士丹利、闪迪、普徕仕、Tether Investments、Virtu Financial 和 XTX Markets。

Tenstorrent 表示，在今年早些时候收到收购意向后，此轮融资旨在保持公司独立，使 AI 加速器市场在英伟达之外保留一家替代供应商。公司计划用这笔资金大规模部署 Galaxy 服务器，服务开放权重的大语言模型和视频生成模型。

投资方名单还包括 Agostinelli Group、Brett Barna、Cadence Ventures、Eclipse、Maverick Silicon、Protagonist、Troluce Capital 和 Tether Investments。除服务器部署外，Tenstorrent 还将把资金用于向自研芯片的客户授权其 AI 和 CPU 知识产权。
summary.en:
AI chip company Tenstorrent closed a $1.5 billion Series E at a $6.2 billion post-money valuation, the company announced on October 19. The round was led by Trace Capital and Innovation X, with participation from new and existing investors including ARK Invest, Fidelity Management & Research, Morgan Stanley, Sandisk, T. Rowe Price, Tether Investments, Virtu Financial and XTX Markets.

Tenstorrent said it raised the money to stay independent after drawing acquisition interest earlier this year, keeping an alternative supplier of AI accelerators outside the Nvidia orbit. The company plans to use the proceeds to deploy its Galaxy servers at scale for open-weight large language and video generation models.

The investor list also includes Agostinelli Group, Brett Barna, Cadence Ventures, Eclipse, Maverick Silicon, Protagonist, Troluce Capital and Tether Investments. Beyond server deployments, Tenstorrent will put funding toward licensing its AI and CPU intellectual property to customers designing their own chips.

title.zh: 贝莱德提交比特币ETF申请，为IBIT提供下行保护与上行敞口
title.en: BlackRock files for bitcoin ETF offering downside protection and upside exposure to IBIT

summary.zh:
贝莱德已提交一只比特币ETF的申请，该产品旨在提供下行保护，同时保留对其现有iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF（IBIT）的上行敞口。该产品目前处于监管申报阶段，尚未获得批准或推出。

若获批准，该申报将使贝莱德拥有第二只比特币交易所交易产品，面向希望在获得比特币相关收益的同时缓冲部分损失的投资者，而非仅通过IBIT获得现货敞口。

该申报将新基金的上行敞口与IBIT挂钩，IBIT是贝莱德现有的现货比特币ETF，旨在通过交易所交易产品追踪比特币价格。市场上已有类似的受保护比特币产品，例如Calamos的结构化保护ETF和CBOJ，它们将比特币相关敞口与国债及期权叠加策略结合。
summary.en:
BlackRock has filed for a bitcoin ETF that seeks to provide downside protection while keeping upside exposure to its existing iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT). The product is at the regulatory filing stage and has not been approved or launched.

If approved, the filing would give BlackRock a second bitcoin ETP wrapper aimed at investors who want bitcoin-linked returns with a measure of loss buffering, rather than direct spot exposure through IBIT.

The filing ties the new fund's upside exposure to IBIT, BlackRock's existing spot bitcoin ETF, which is designed to track the price of bitcoin through an exchange-traded product. Comparable protected-bitcoin products already on the market, such as Calamos' structured-protection ETFs and CBOJ, pair bitcoin-linked exposure with Treasuries and options overlays.
